items.definition: Havanın, suyun veya toprağın zararlı maddelerle kirletilmesi sonucu ortaya çıkan çevresel bozulma.
exampleSentences: Air pollution in the city has worsened over the last decade.
Factories are being fined for dumping waste that causes water pollution.
Efforts to reduce pollution have improved air quality in several regions.

items.definition: Belirli bir bölgede uzun yıllar boyunca gözlemlenen ortalama hava koşulları.
exampleSentences: The region's climate has become noticeably warmer over the past fifty years.
Scientists warn that climate change is accelerating faster than predicted.
Farmers had to adapt their crops to the changing climate.

items.definition: Milyonlarca yıl önce ölmüş canlıların kalıntılarından oluşan; bu kalıntılardan elde edilen (yakıt için).
exampleSentences: Burning fossil fuels releases large amounts of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
Countries are under pressure to reduce their reliance on fossil energy.
The museum displayed fossil remains found near the coast.

items.definition: Doğada sürekli yenilenebilen, tükenmeyen kaynaklardan elde edilen (enerji için).
exampleSentences: Solar and wind are among the fastest-growing sources of renewable energy.
The government set a target to generate half its electricity from renewables by 2030.
Investing in renewable technology can reduce long-term energy costs.

items.definition: Özellikle motorlu araçlar veya fabrikalar tarafından atmosfere salınan gaz veya madde.
exampleSentences: The new regulations aim to cut carbon emissions from vehicles.
Factories are required to monitor their emissions of harmful gases.
Electric cars produce zero emissions while driving.

items.definition: Bir canlı türünün doğal olarak yaşadığı ve geliştiği ortam.
exampleSentences: Deforestation is destroying the natural habitat of many species.
The reserve was created to protect the habitat of endangered birds.
Rising sea temperatures are altering marine habitats around the world.

items.definition: Ortak özellikleri paylaşan ve kendi aralarında üreyebilen canlılar grubu.
exampleSentences: Several species of frog have disappeared from the wetland in recent years.
The report lists over a hundred species currently at risk of extinction.
Scientists discovered a new species of beetle in the rainforest.

items.definition: Kullanıldıktan sonra artık gereksiz veya istenmeyen hale gelen ve atılan madde.
exampleSentences: The city introduced new bins to separate recyclable waste from general rubbish.
Industrial waste from the factory was polluting the nearby river.
Reducing food waste is one of the simplest ways households can help the environment.

items.definition: Kullanılmış bir malzemeyi yeniden işleyerek tekrar kullanılabilir hale getirmek.
exampleSentences: Most households now recycle paper, glass and plastic separately.
The council encourages residents to recycle as much waste as possible.
Old bottles can be recycled into new glass products.

items.definition: Uzun süre yeterli yağış olmaması nedeniyle ortaya çıkan ciddi su kıtlığı dönemi.
exampleSentences: The region has suffered its worst drought in fifty years.
Farmers lost most of their crops during the prolonged drought.
Water restrictions were introduced as the drought continued into summer.

items.definition: Belirli bir ortamda birbiriyle ve çevreleriyle etkileşim içinde bulunan canlılar ve cansız unsurların bütünü.
exampleSentences: Coral reefs support one of the most diverse ecosystems on the planet.
Removing a single species can disrupt the balance of an entire ecosystem.
The wetland ecosystem provides a natural habitat for hundreds of bird species.

items.definition: Bir bölgedeki veya dünyadaki canlı türlerinin çeşitliliği.
exampleSentences: The rainforest is home to an extraordinary level of biodiversity.
Loss of biodiversity threatens the stability of ecosystems worldwide.
The park was established to protect the region's biodiversity.

items.definition: Toprağın veya kayaların rüzgâr, su gibi doğal etkenlerle aşınıp taşınması.
exampleSentences: Deforestation has accelerated soil erosion along the riverbanks.
Coastal erosion has caused several homes to be abandoned.
Planting trees can help prevent erosion on steep hillsides.

items.definition: Doğal kaynakların, türlerin veya ekosistemlerin korunmasına yönelik çaba veya uygulama.
exampleSentences: The organisation funds conservation projects across the region.
Wildlife conservation depends heavily on local community support.
Water conservation has become a priority during the drought.

items.definition: Doğal kaynakları tüketmeden veya çevreye kalıcı zarar vermeden uzun vadede sürdürülebilen.
exampleSentences: The company shifted to more sustainable packaging to reduce plastic waste.
Sustainable farming methods help preserve soil quality for future generations.
Cities are investing in sustainable transport to cut emissions.

items.definition: Atmosferde ısıyı tutarak dünyanın ısınmasına yol açan (gaz için); ayrıca bitki yetiştirmek için kullanılan camdan yapı.
exampleSentences: Carbon dioxide is one of the main greenhouse gases contributing to global warming.
The greenhouse effect traps heat within the Earth's atmosphere.
Reducing greenhouse gas emissions is central to most climate agreements.

items.definition: Dünyayı çevreleyen ve çeşitli gazlardan oluşan hava tabakası.
exampleSentences: Carbon emissions accumulate in the atmosphere and trap heat.
The upper atmosphere protects the Earth from harmful solar radiation.
Volcanic eruptions can release large amounts of ash into the atmosphere.

items.definition: Bir türün tüm bireylerinin ortadan kalkması ve tamamen yok olması durumu.
exampleSentences: Hunting and habitat loss pushed the species to the brink of extinction.
Conservationists are working to prevent the extinction of the rare tortoise.
Scientists estimate that thousands of species face extinction within decades.

items.definition: Bir maddenin, suyun veya toprağın zararlı veya istenmeyen bir maddeyle kirlenmesi.
exampleSentences: Contamination of the local water supply forced the town to issue a warning.
Soil contamination near the factory has affected nearby farmland.
Strict testing is used to detect contamination before food reaches shelves.

items.definition: Doğal ortamında yaşayan yabani hayvan ve bitkilerin tümü.
exampleSentences: The reserve was created to protect the region's wildlife.
Poaching remains one of the biggest threats to African wildlife.
Volunteers help rehabilitate injured wildlife before releasing them back into the wild.

items.definition: Güneşten gelen ışık veya ısı enerjisiyle ilgili olan ya da bu enerjiden elde edilen.
exampleSentences: The house is powered entirely by solar panels installed on the roof.
Solar energy has become significantly cheaper over the past decade.
Many countries are expanding their solar power capacity to cut emissions.

items.definition: Atom çekirdeğinin parçalanması veya birleşmesiyle açığa çıkan enerjiyle ilgili olan.
exampleSentences: The country generates a large share of its electricity from nuclear power.
Concerns about safety have slowed the construction of new nuclear plants.
Nuclear energy produces far fewer emissions than fossil fuels.

items.definition: Rüzgâr, su veya buhar gücüyle dönerek mekanik enerjiyi elektrik enerjisine dönüştüren makine.
exampleSentences: Wind turbines line the hillside, generating power for the nearby town.
Engineers inspected the turbine after it began making an unusual noise.
The dam uses turbines to convert flowing water into electricity.

items.definition: Yakılarak ısı veya enerji üretmek amacıyla kullanılan madde.
exampleSentences: Rising fuel prices have pushed up the cost of transport across the country.
The car runs on a mixture of petrol and biofuel.
Countries are looking for alternatives to fuel their economies without fossil sources.

items.definition: Aydınlatma, ısıtma ve makinelerin çalıştırılması gibi amaçlarla kullanılan enerji türü.
exampleSentences: The village finally got access to electricity last year.
Electricity generated from wind farms now supplies a fifth of the country's needs.
A sudden storm cut off electricity to thousands of homes.

items.definition: Elektriğin üretim noktalarından kullanıcılara iletilmesini sağlayan bağlantılı şebeke sistemi.
exampleSentences: Solar farms feed excess electricity back into the national grid.
A single fault caused a blackout across much of the grid.
Upgrading the grid is essential to support renewable energy sources.

items.definition: Bir sistemin veya sürecin enerjiyi, zamanı veya kaynakları en az kayıpla kullanabilme derecesi.
exampleSentences: New insulation greatly improved the building's energy efficiency.
Manufacturers are competing to increase the fuel efficiency of their vehicles.
Efficiency gains in solar technology have lowered the cost of electricity.

items.definition: Atmosferin üst katmanlarında bulunan ve zararlı güneş ışınlarını filtreleyen gaz.
exampleSentences: Certain chemicals were found to be depleting the ozone layer.
International agreements helped the ozone layer begin to recover.
A hole in the ozone layer was first detected over Antarctica.

items.definition: Ormanların tarım, yerleşim veya diğer amaçlarla geniş ölçekte yok edilmesi.
exampleSentences: Deforestation in the Amazon has accelerated in recent years.
Widespread deforestation is a major driver of species loss.
The government introduced measures to slow deforestation in protected areas.

items.definition: Yüksek dağlarda veya kutup bölgelerinde uzun süre birikip sıkışan buzdan oluşan büyük buz kütlesi.
exampleSentences: The glacier has retreated significantly over the past thirty years.
Melting glaciers are contributing to rising sea levels around the world.
Scientists monitor the glacier to track the effects of a warming climate.

items.definition: Canlıların ve fosil yakıtların temel yapı taşı olan element; çevre bağlamında çoğunlukla fosil yakıtların yanmasıyla açığa çıkan karbondioksit salımı anlamında kullanılır.
exampleSentences: The company pledged to cut its carbon footprint by half within five years.
Planting trees is one way to offset carbon emissions.
Governments are taxing carbon output to encourage cleaner industry.

items.definition: Bir zararı veya olumsuz etkiyi azaltmak ya da hafifletmek için önlem almak.
exampleSentences: Building sea walls can help mitigate the effects of rising water levels.
The plan outlines steps to mitigate the environmental impact of the project.
Countries are working together to mitigate the worst effects of climate change.

items.definition: Canlıların birbiriyle ve çevreleriyle olan ilişkileriyle, yani ekolojiyle ilgili olan.
exampleSentences: The dam's construction caused serious ecological damage to the river system.
Scientists warned of the ecological consequences of continued deforestation.
The report assessed the ecological impact of the new pipeline.

items.definition: Sayısı çok azaldığı için soyunun tükenme tehlikesiyle karşı karşıya olan (tür için).
exampleSentences: The panda remains one of the world's most endangered species.
Poaching has pushed several endangered animals closer to extinction.
The reserve protects habitat for a number of endangered birds.

items.definition: Tarım arazilerine yapay yollarla su sağlanması işlemi.
exampleSentences: The farmers rely on irrigation to grow crops in the dry season.
Poor irrigation practices can lead to soil salinisation over time.
The government funded a new irrigation system for the valley's farms.

items.definition: Katı atıkların toprağa gömülerek bertaraf edildiği alan.
exampleSentences: Most household rubbish still ends up in landfill rather than being recycled.
The city is running out of space for new landfill sites.
Reducing packaging waste helps keep plastic out of landfill.

items.definition: Zararlı böcekleri, otları veya diğer istenmeyen organizmaları yok etmek için kullanılan kimyasal madde.
exampleSentences: Overuse of pesticide has been linked to declining bee populations.
Farmers are switching to organic methods to reduce pesticide use.
Traces of pesticide were found in the local water supply.

items.definition: Canlılara zarar verebilecek ya da öldürebilecek nitelikte zehirli olan.
exampleSentences: The factory was fined for releasing toxic chemicals into the river.
Exposure to toxic fumes can cause long-term health problems.
The clean-up crew wore protective suits to handle the toxic waste.

items.definition: Evlerden ve fabrikalardan gelen kirli su ve atıkların oluşturduğu karışım.
exampleSentences: Untreated sewage was being discharged directly into the bay.
The city upgraded its sewage treatment plant to reduce pollution.
Heavy rains overwhelmed the sewage system, causing flooding in the streets.

items.definition: Bir zararı veya etkiyi başka bir olumlu eylemle dengelemek ya da telafi etmek.
exampleSentences: The airline allows passengers to offset the carbon emissions from their flight.
Planting new forests can help offset the loss of tree cover elsewhere.
The company invests in renewable projects to offset its own emissions.
items.translationTR: dengelemek, telafi etmek (özellikle karbon salımı için)

items.definition: Enerji üretmek amacıyla kullanılan bitkisel veya hayvansal kökenli organik madde.
exampleSentences: The power plant burns biomass instead of coal to generate electricity.
Farmers can sell agricultural waste to biomass energy producers.
Biomass is considered renewable because the plants used can be regrown.

items.definition: Yerkabuğunun derinliklerindeki ısıdan elde edilen (enerji için).
exampleSentences: Iceland generates much of its electricity from geothermal energy.
The region's volcanic activity makes it well suited for geothermal power.
Geothermal heating systems can significantly reduce a building's energy use.

items.definition: Yağan suyun belirli bir nehir veya göle aktığı toprak alanı; su toplama havzası.
exampleSentences: Protecting the watershed helps ensure a clean water supply for the whole region.
Deforestation upstream affects the entire watershed's water quality.
The organisation monitors pollution levels across several watersheds.

items.definition: Toprağın verimliliğini artırmak amacıyla eklenen doğal veya kimyasal madde.
exampleSentences: Excess fertiliser running off farmland can pollute nearby rivers.
Farmers apply fertiliser to boost crop yields before the growing season.
Organic fertiliser is often preferred over synthetic alternatives.

items.definition: Akan veya düşen suyun gücünden elektrik üreten (santral veya enerji için).
exampleSentences: The dam operates a large hydroelectric power station.
Hydroelectric energy accounts for a significant share of the country's electricity.
Building the hydroelectric plant required flooding an entire valley.

items.definition: Çok az yağış alan, kurak ve verimsiz (iklim veya toprak için).
exampleSentences: Much of the country's interior consists of arid desert land.
Farmers struggle to grow crops in such an arid climate.
The plant has adapted to survive in extremely arid conditions.

items.definition: Yağmur, kar veya dolu şeklinde atmosferden yeryüzüne düşen su.
exampleSentences: Annual precipitation in the region has declined noticeably over the past decade.
The forecast predicts heavy precipitation later this week.
Changes in precipitation patterns are affecting crop yields worldwide.

items.definition: Bir çevrenin, toprağın veya ekosistemin kalitesinin zamanla bozulması.
exampleSentences: Soil degradation has reduced the land's ability to support crops.
Environmental degradation caused by mining has damaged the surrounding forest.
The report highlights the degradation of coastal wetlands over the past decade.

items.definition: Bir bölgede tarihsel olarak sonradan gelmemiş, oraya özgü ve o bölgede doğal olarak var olan.
exampleSentences: Indigenous communities have managed the forest sustainably for generations.
The plant is indigenous to the wetlands of the region.
Indigenous knowledge has proven valuable in conservation efforts.

items.definition: Dünya üzerinde canlıların yaşadığı ve birbirleriyle etkileşimde bulunduğu bölgelerin tümü.
exampleSentences: Human activity is placing unprecedented pressure on the Earth's biosphere.
The reserve was designated a protected biosphere by international agreement.
Scientists study how pollutants move through the biosphere.

items.definition: Bir kaynağın miktarının aşırı kullanım sonucu giderek azalması veya tükenmesi.
exampleSentences: The depletion of fish stocks has forced many fishing communities to look for other work.
Ozone depletion was a major environmental concern in the 1980s.
Continued depletion of groundwater threatens the region's water supply.

items.definition: Sınırlı miktarda olan ve tükenebilen, sonsuz olmayan.
exampleSentences: Fossil fuels are a finite resource that cannot be replenished quickly.
Planners must recognise that the region's water supply is finite.
The Earth has only a finite amount of arable land.

items.definition: Bir kaynağı, genellikle aşırı veya sorumsuz biçimde, kendi çıkarı için kullanmak.
exampleSentences: Companies have been criticised for exploiting natural resources without regard for the environment.
The region's forests have been exploited for timber for over a century.
New technology allows energy companies to exploit deposits that were once inaccessible.

items.definition: Doğal bir alanın, türün veya kaynağın bozulmadan korunması.
exampleSentences: The preservation of wetlands is essential for maintaining local biodiversity.
Volunteers dedicate their time to the preservation of the coastal forest.
Preservation efforts have helped bring several species back from the brink.

items.definition: Zorlu koşullara veya değişime dayanabilen, kolayca zarar görmeyen.
exampleSentences: Coral reefs that are exposed to moderate stress can become more resilient over time.
Farmers are adopting crops that are more resilient to drought.
A resilient ecosystem can recover more quickly after a natural disaster.

items.definition: Zarar görmeye veya olumsuz etkilenmeye açık, savunmasız.
exampleSentences: Low-lying coastal areas are especially vulnerable to rising sea levels.
Small island nations remain among the most vulnerable to climate change.
The species is vulnerable because its habitat continues to shrink.

items.definition: Zararlı veya olumsuz sonuçlar doğuran.
exampleSentences: The chemical spill had an adverse effect on marine life in the bay.
Adverse weather conditions delayed the construction of the wind farm.
Scientists documented the adverse impact of the drought on local agriculture.

items.definition: Azalmış veya tükenmiş bir kaynağı yeniden doldurmak veya tamamlamak.
exampleSentences: Heavy winter rains helped replenish the reservoir after months of drought.
Sustainable fishing gives fish populations time to replenish.
The aquifer takes decades to replenish once it has been drained.

items.definition: Çok büyük zarara veya yıkıma yol açan, felaket niteliğinde.
exampleSentences: The oil spill had a catastrophic effect on the coastal ecosystem.
Scientists warned that unchecked emissions could lead to catastrophic climate change.
The flood was catastrophic for farmers who lost their entire harvest.

items.definition: İnsan sağlığına veya çevreye ciddi zarar verme riski taşıyan, tehlikeli.
exampleSentences: The factory was fined for improperly disposing of hazardous waste.
Workers wore protective gear while handling hazardous chemicals.
The abandoned site was declared hazardous and closed to the public.
